item.title: Police investigating after man hit, killed in West Jordan
item.description: Police are investigating a fatal car crash that occurred Sunday evening.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie kidnapping investigators work with Walmart after identifying suspect’s backpack
item.description: Investigators working on the disappearance of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie’s mother are consulting with Walmart management to develop leads. That's because a backpack the suspect was wearing is sold exclusively at Walmart stores.

item.title: Utah’s 2026 Recruiting Class: Scouting Reports & Program Vision
item.description: With the transfer portal on the horizon, there is plenty more roster movement coming but Alex Jensen's first recruiting class provides direction for Utah basketball.

item.title: Utah company works with Team Jamaica to make Olympic comeback
item.description: The Olympic Jamaican bobsled team is working to make a comeback, and a Utah company is supporting it through the Milan-Cortina Winter Games.

item.title: Moms over 40 power Team USA to Monobob medals
item.description: It was not a great night for Team U.S.A.'s Kaysha Love of Herriman, who finished seventh in women's monobob, but it was a big night for moms of a certain age.

item.title: Forecasters warn about atypical avalanche conditions with storms looming
item.description: As storms promise to start covering the state in snow, forecasters and experts warn that the new snow could create perfect conditions for avalanches.

item.title: Family rebuilds home after, they say, mold caused daughter’s extreme illness
item.description: The family of a Heber Valley girl says hidden black mold in their century-old home was making her seriously sick. It got so bad that they decided to tear it down and rebuild.

item.title: Tooele County confirms first case of measles
item.description: Health officials in Tooele County confirmed the county's first case of measles Monday night.

item.title: West Jordan neighborhood grieves after mother–daughter murder‑suicide
item.description: Tears and heartbreak are sweeping through a West Jordan neighborhood after news spread of a tragic murder‑suicide involving a mother and her young daughter.

item.title: The husband-and-wife team behind Salt Lake City’s newest viral attraction
item.description: Hidden underground downtown Salt Lake City is a mysterious lair that seemingly transports visitors to another time and another place reminiscent of a train station located halfway around the world.
